title: cystanthe scoparia

It is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which may help in the management of various health conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Cystanthe scoparia include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
